invariants.statement: The clone serves only same-origin HTML, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, images and API responses. Every remote runtime request is forbidden.
acceptance_obligations: Browser evidence records zero non-same-origin requests on every checkpoint route.
Served text files carry no remote runtime reference; vendored CSS is locally closed.

invariants.statement: Signing in rotates the session token; the pre-login token stops resolving. The clone writes the rotated token back to the cookie.
acceptance_obligations: The post-login cookie value differs from the pre-login one.
The pre-login token resolves to an anonymous session afterwards.

invariants.statement: A wrong password and an address with no account return the same error code, so the clone does not disclose which addresses have accounts.
acceptance_obligations: Both cases return HTTP 401 with code invalid-credentials.

invariants.statement: No source credential, session cookie or personal datum from the capture account leaves in the delivered bytes. Captured logged-in DOM is PII-scrubbed at rest with equal-length, equal-class substitution.
acceptance_obligations: run/ is excluded from delivery and the outgoing byte stream is scanned.
Assertions use positive allow-set membership, never the forbidden literal.

invariants.statement: Where capture was bounded, links do not point at nothing: an in-scope-shaped but uncaptured route serves a declared scope-boundary page, distinct from a source 404.
acceptance_obligations: An uncaptured /m/search/<city>/<category> returns the boundary page with HTTP 200.
A route the source does not serve returns HTTP 404.
